_about: Where each document's status lives in the SIT database (NGEP_SIT), read-only. Used by support/core/doc-status.ts, the flow runner's DB status check, the generated SQL in sql/status/ and `npm run qa -- doc-status`. verified=true only when a document of ours showed a matching history (evidence). Status names: PM_STATUS_DESC (language_code 'en' / 'ms'). BPM tasks: SIT01_SOAINFRA.WFTASK over the database link SITSOA (CUSTOMATTRIBUTESTRING1 = document number), verified 2026-11-23 with LA260000000004227 (Verify Manual LOA ASSIGNED 710527085562). NGEP_SIT.MV_WFTASK is stale (last refresh 2022, newest row 2019): never use it.
